create.name: Chinmaya Mission Vancouver
create.bio:
Chinmaya Mission Vancouver is the British Columbia centre of the worldwide Chinmaya Mission, started in 1972 by students of Swami Chinmayananda. It is a volunteer-run community: trained lay teachers lead its classes, with talks and jnana yajnas from visiting acharyas of the mission, and its in-person meetings take place at a school in New Westminster, east of Vancouver, alongside a full timetable on Zoom.

The centre teaches Advaita Vedanta in the Chinmaya tradition, approaching the Bhagavad Gita, the Upanishads and short teaching manuals through study and open discussion rather than belief. Adults can join an introductory course on the fundamentals of Vedanta, in person or online, a Sunday class going verse by verse through the Gita, a Friday class on the Mandukya Upanishad and a short weekly Gita chanting session; the adult classes are always free. On Sunday mornings children from kindergarten to grade twelve attend Bala Vihar, learning stories, chants, values and culture from trained volunteers, and a youth group, Chinmaya Yuva Kendra, meets for satsang and service. Members support the work with a yearly fee, and recordings of the long-running Gita series are posted on the centre's own YouTube channel.

courses.title: Membership
courses.description: Yearly membership that supports the centre's classes and jnana yajnas and gives a vote at the annual meeting. A family membership is required for children attending Bala Vihar; adult classes stay free for everyone.

free_resources.title: Adult Classes
free_resources.description: Weekly discussion-based study of Vedantic texts: Fundamentals of Vedanta in person and online, a Sunday Gita class, a Friday class on the Mandukya Upanishad and a short Gita chanting session. Free of charge.

free_resources.title: Bala Vihar (K-12)
free_resources.description: Sunday morning classes in New Westminster for school-age children, teaching culture, values and scripture through stories, games, chants and crafts, led by trained volunteers.

free_resources.title: Chinmaya Yuva Kendra (youth)
free_resources.description: The centre's youth and young adult group, meeting for Vedanta study, satsang and community service.
